Could almost be fantastic
Jan 2022 • Couples
The quality of the ingredients here are good, however it was a big let down the food arrived cold.

I had the banh mi with eggs and sausage and my partner had the bún bò. The kitchen managed to reheat mine well and it was great. However, after my partner asking for her bún bò to be reheated it still wasn’t very hot. She gave up and just ate it as we had already waiting for the food a long time.

The coffee is excellent and I highly recommend the coconut coffee.

Overall it’s a nice atmosphere here. It’s just a shame they have trouble serving their food hot.
